elements.label: Isometric wall of integration logo tiles (pulls back so many more tiles fill the frame)

pattern.description: The camera pulls back fast over an isometric grid of integration logo tiles, so the tiles shrink and many more come into view. The headline 'With 450+ turn-key integrations' stays fixed and sharp on a soft white band over the wall.
pattern.why_premium: The pull-back shows the '450+' scale visually: the viewer sees the count of tiles grow instead of reading a number. The pinned headline with a soft fade behind it keeps the text readable while the busy wall moves underneath.

build_hint.gsap: Headline on its own fixed layer (no tween). tl.fromTo('.logo-wall',{scale:1.7},{scale:1,duration:0.45,ease:'power2.inOut',transformOrigin:'50% 50%'}); keep the wall on an isometric parent (rotateX(55deg) rotateZ(-45deg)) with an oversized tiled grid so edges never show; add a radial white gradient behind the headline.
build_hint.remotion: wallScale = interpolate(frame,[0,13],[1.7,1],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic),extrapolateRight:'clamp'}) applied to the isometric logo grid container; headline AbsoluteFill above it with no animation.

notes: The headline (b03) is static in every frame, so it is not listed. Camera verdict is pull_out (scale 0.59), and it applies to the logo wall layer only.
